mapper.select:
SELECT art.id productId, art.`name`, art.serial_number, ext.sort_number number, taskReport.id, bgr.teamId teamId, userLink.user_name leaderName, numberLink.id, tprocess.id taskProcessId, shop.id workshopId, shop.`name` workshopName, line.id lineId, line.`name` lineName, bgr.id groupId, bgr.`name` groupName, IF (( ifnull( wrecord.id, 0 ) + ifnull( carNumber.id, 0 ) + ifnull( packageNumber.id, 0 )) > 0, 0, 1 ) AS boolCargo, CASE
WHEN numberLink.id IS NULL THEN '未下发' WHEN wrecord.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已发运' WHEN carNumber.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已装车' WHEN packageNumber.id IS NOT NULL THEN '已打包' WHEN numberLink.bool_artifact_complete = 1 THEN '已完成' ELSE process.`name` END AS processName, numberLink.bool_artifact_report boolReport, numberLink.bool_artifact_inspection boolInspection, numberLink.bool_artifact_complete boolComplete FROM tech_artifact art LEFT JOIN tech_artifact_ext ext ON art.id = ext.artifact_id AND ext.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_number_link numberLink ON ext.artifact_id = numberLink.artifact_id AND ext.sort_number = numberLink.artifact_number AND numberLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process tprocess ON numberLink.artifact_task_process_id = tprocess.id AND tprocess.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON numberLink.artifact_task_id = task.id AND task.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop shop ON task.workshop_id = shop.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON task.production_line_id = line.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bgr.id id, bgr.`name` NAME, taskTeam.id teamId, taskTeam.process_id processId FROM mes_building_groups bgr LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups_team_link groupsLink ON bgr.id = groupsLink.groups_id AND groupsLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team taskTeam ON taskTeam.id = groupsLink.team_id WHERE bgr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND taskTeam.bool_delete_enum = 0 ) bgr ON task.groups_id = bgr.id AND bgr.processId = tprocess.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link userLink ON userLink.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND userLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND bgr.teamId = userLink.team_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_record wrecord ON ext.artifact_id = wrecord.product_id AND wrecord.number = ext.sort_number AND wrecord.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wrecord.type = 2 LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report taskReport ON taskReport.product_id = ext.artifact_id AND taskReport.number = ext.sort_number AND taskReport.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND taskReport.task_type_enum = 2 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON tprocess.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list_product_number_link carNumber ON carNumber.product_id = ext.artifact_id AND carNumber.number = ext.sort_number AND carNumber.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND carNumber.product_type = 2 AND carNumber.bool_cancel_ship = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_package_number_link packageNumber ON packageNumber.product_id = ext.artifact_id AND packageNumber.number = ext.sort_number AND packageNumber.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND packageNumber.product_type = 2 WHERE art.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND art.id IN
#{artifactId}

SELECT * FROM mes_building_task_number_link WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
AND (artifact_id, artifact_number) IN
(#{number.productId}, #{number.number})
AND (assemble_id, assemble_number) IN
(#{number.productId}, #{number.number})

SELECT link.artifact_id, link.artifact_number, link.assemble_id, link.assemble_number, record.`status` FROM mes_building_task_number_link link INNER JOIN mes_building_warehouse_record record ON record.product_id = link.assemble_id AND record.number = link.assemble_number AND record.type = 1 AND record.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND record.product_type = 16
AND (link.artifact_id, link.artifact_number) IN
(#{number.productId}, #{number.number})
